sources.entry: SteerMouse - Customize mouse buttons, wheel behavior, and cursor speed.

summary.name: SteerMouse
summary.one_liner: SteerMouse is a paid macOS utility for customizing mouse buttons, scroll behavior, cursor speed and cursor movement.
use_cases: Remap mouse buttons to keyboard shortcuts on a Mac
Adjust mouse sensitivity and tracking speed beyond System Settings
Smooth out scroll speed and enable hands-free scrolling
Automatically move the cursor to default or close buttons in dialogs
Configure different mouse behavior for each application
summary.what_it_does: SteerMouse lets you assign functions to mouse buttons, alone or combined with modifier keys (command, shift, option, control) and with other buttons, with 24 functions per button. Available functions include keyboard shortcuts, clicks (double click, click lock), scrolling, zoom, application switching, Mission Control, system controls, music controls, and opening files or URLs. It adds sensitivity adjustment on top of macOS tracking speed and scroll acceleration controls. Cursor Snapping moves the pointer to default or close buttons, and settings can be configured per application.
notable: 24 functions per button with modifier and chording combinations
Adds sensitivity adjustment on top of the system tracking speed
Cursor Snapping with animated movement and optional auto-click
caveats: New license costs US$19.99; upgrade from version 4 costs US$12.99; free trial lasts 30 days
Major upgrades (e.g. 5.0 to 6.0) are charged; SteerMouse 4 is no longer updated
Mouse settings are not carried over when upgrading from SteerMouse 4
